v19-10.candidate: Each of you shall give them clear instruction about any judgment that comes before you from your brethren dwelling in their cities—between blood and blood, between ordinance and commandment, and statutes and judgments. They will not sin against the Lord, and wrath will not come upon you and your brethren. This is how you shall act, and you shall not sin.
v19-10.close: Whatever judgment comes before you from your brethren dwelling in their cities, between blood and blood, between ordinance and commandment, and statutes and judgments, you shall give them clear instruction, so that they do not sin against the Lord, and wrath does not come upon you and your brethren. This is how you shall act, and you shall not sin.

v20-21.display:
He consulted the people and appointed psalm singers and those giving praise, to give thanks and praise the holy things as they went out before the army. They said,
“Give thanks to the Lord,
for His mercy is for ever.”
